GRAPHIC DESIGN STUDIO

KNOWN
Studio.

Every piece starts with a story worth telling — book covers, logo design, character illustration, and everything else Adobe Illustrator can do, plus video editing to bring it all to motion. Colour, type and layout are pushed to work together so each design reads like a single idea, not a stack of decisions.

Sri Lanka

What I Do

Services

Design work built entirely in Adobe Illustrator, plus video editing for anything that needs to move.

01

Book Cover Design

Full wrap covers — front, spine, and back — built as one composition, not three separate pieces.

02

Logo Design

Marks built to hold up at any size, from a favicon to a shopfront — clean vector construction every time.

03

Illustration

Character art, posters, merch-ready graphics — anything Adobe Illustrator can produce, from concept to final vector.

04

Video Editing

Cutting, pacing, and finishing footage into something worth watching — reels, intros, and short-form edits.

Profile

M.A.T.D.

The person behind Known Studio Lk.

M.A.T.D.

Currently an A/L student, with graphic design as a serious side pursuit — building book covers, character art, and brand work in Adobe Illustrator is where the creative energy goes outside of school.

Also active on the badminton court as part of the "Shuttle Smashers" team, and stepping into a school leadership role. Whether it's a character or a cover, the focus is always the same: attention to detail, and giving every piece a distinct personality.
